asset_rule: Every visual content record references a stable AssetSlot. Upload/import pipeline may replace slot payload without changing gameplay IDs.
no_code_rule: Creating records of these supported types must not require a client code deployment.
security_rule: Admin content may compose only whitelisted behavior components; it cannot upload/execute arbitrary gameplay code.
